display_long_description:
You're a penguin with very long wings, and something in the dark is hungry.

Penguin Panic is a free-to-play multiplayer horror game where you move with your arms. Slap the ground to run, fling yourself into jumps, grab ladders and climb. No thumbsticks, just wings.

WORLDS
- The Maze: a giant pitch-black maze. Eat glowing pellets, grab a power orb and turn the hunters into the hunted. Beware the Shade.
- The Tower: climb nine floors of girders while a giant ghost hurls barrels at you.
- The Crossing: haunted roads and a black river. Dodge hearses, ride rotting logs, light the cemetery lanterns.
- Snake: race a giant snake for apples in the dark.
- The Backrooms: endless yellow offices and a tall grinning thing that hunts you when the lights go out.
- Containment Breach: pull the breakers and get out before the statue reaches you. Don't blink.

PLAY TOGETHER
Online rooms for up to 8 penguins, private room codes for friends, and proximity voice chat with per-player mute.

DRESS UP
Earn Fish by playing and from daily rewards, then spend them in the Fish & Feathers shop: hats, skins, wings, pets, wing-tap sounds and name tags. Try anything on in the magic mirror for free. Everything is cosmetic, with no loot boxes. Optional Fish packs are available.

Early Access: new levels and limited-time items are added regularly.

Contains horror themes, jump scares and optional blood effects (can be turned off in the menu). Voice chat needs microphone permission.
